text:
juno: kicking off deploy: runtime-worker v4.1 during quiet window. featureflag enable_llm_v4 ramp plan: 0 -> 0.03 (canary 6 hosts) -> 0.15 -> 0.5 -> 1.0 over 40m. enterprise customers pinned to model=v3.7 until final gate. release notes staged: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-23/runtime-v4.1

marco: ack. please insert deploybot holdpoint after the 0.15 step. gates: error_rate > 2% OR p95 latency +25% OR model-quality delta > 1.0% -> pause and notify #eng-oncall. enable soft-session-drain 10m for canary. :thumbsup:

deploybot: automated: created canary group G (6 hosts). flag enable_llm_v4 -> 0.03. telemetry stream /ops/telemetry/deploy/7790011223 live. holdpoint scheduled at step 3.

leah: running smoke suite (smoke_quick) and eval set (regset_v4). quality gate: f1_delta <= 0.9% and rollback if rouge_delta > 1.2%. also watching cache-hit and fallback-rate.

juno: note: routing-pin rule applied for enterprise cohort -> model=v3.7, enforced until gate cleared. ops-bot pinged support and security slack.

marco: quick rollback snippet for ops clipboard:
```
# revert flag and drain canary
curl -s -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood/flags/enable_llm_v4 -d '{"value":0}'
deploybot action: drain --group canaryG --timeout 600
```

deploybot: canary G @ +7m metrics: error_rate=0.8% p95=220ms (+10%) token_cost=+4%. regset_v4 quality delta=+0.4% (ok). cache-hit stable. proceeding to 0.15 in 6m.

juno: will watch p50 and fallback-rate closely. if anything crosses thresholds marco will fast-drain and pin routing back. deploybot: scheduled promote to 1.0 at 01:05 UTC unless stopped. updates in 10m or on gate trip. :eyes:
